subject: R aborted when trying to add metadata into tree with tibble full_join

messages.author: 65c64f8e9ca0856a
messages.subject: R aborted when trying to add metadata into tree with tibble full_join
parts:
Hello, I got an issue when trying to add metadata on my tree:

here is the tree:



tree <-
structure(list(edge = structure(c(13L, 14L, 15L, 16L, 17L, 18L,
19L, 19L, 18L, 17L, 16L, 15L, 20L, 20L, 14L, 21L, 21L, 13L, 22L,
22L, 23L, 23L, 14L, 15L, 16L, 17L, 18L, 19L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L,
9L, 20L, 7L, 8L, 21L, 5L, 6L, 22L, 10L, 23L, 11L, 12L), .Dim = c(22L,
2L)), edge.length = c(0.4741914879, 0.0606263444, 0.1427482127,
0.0836374533, 0.405747684, 0.0979910062, 0.1357120409, 0.0794631914,
0.0861335837, 0.6693699494, 1.144996971, 0.4931972115, 0.4409983357,
0.4412279821, 0.0957999921, 0.9480669221, 1.127060976, 0.7289752119,
1.0935878043, 0.6091491479, 2.5842e-06, 0.0053554342), Nnode = 11L,
    node.label = c("Root", "71.5", "87.6", "40.4", "100", "99.8",
    "", "100", "73.1", "100", "100"), tip.label = c("SP1",
    "SP2", "SP3",
    "SP4", "SP5",
    "SP6", "SP7",
    "SP8", "SP9",
    "YP_001883398", "AMB48645", "YP_001686988")), class = "phylo", order = "cladewise")

Then I transform the tree into a tibble format:


table1.1 <- as_tibble(tree)


Then as in the tutorial https://yulab-smu.github.io/treedata-book/chapter2.html :

I join a metada to the tree :

metadata<-structure(list(label = c("SP1",
"SP2", "SP3",
"SP4", "SP5",
"SP6", "SP7",
"SP8", "SP9",
"YP_001883398", "AMB48645", "YP_001686988", "Root", "71.5", "87.6",
"40.4", "100", "99.8", "", "100", "73.1", "100", "100"), dN_vs_dS = c(NA,
NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
"0.097*", NA, "0.0026*", NA, NA, NA)), row.names = c(NA, -23L
), class = c("tbl_df", "tbl", "data.frame"))


y<-full_join(tree , metadata, by = 'label')


but then when I run :

ggtree(y)

R is out and aborted ...

Do you have an idea what is going on ?

messages.author: 48f5ec8bf2672921
messages.subject: Re: R aborted when trying to add metadata into tree with tibble full_join
parts:
full_join is not be used to merge phylo class and tbl_df class. I think you can use the table1.1 instead of tree, since tree is a phylo class. y <- full_join(table1.1, metadata, by="label")

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: R aborted when trying to add metadata into tree with tibble full_join
parts:
full_join supports both phylo and tbl_tree objects.

The problem here is the user try to merge a tree with annotation data using labels that are not unique to corresponding nodes.

> tail(metadata)
# A tibble: 6 x 2
  label  dN_vs_dS
  <chr>  <chr>   
1 "99.8" 0.097*  
2 ""     NA      
3 "100"  0.0026* 
4 "73.1" NA      
5 "100"  NA      
6 "100"  NA

As we can see that there are multiple “100”, the full_join will try to keep all these possibilities.

> tree

Phylogenetic tree with 12 tips and 11 internal nodes.

Tip labels:
    SP1, SP2, SP3, SP4, SP5, SP6, ...
Node labels:
    Root, 71.5, 87.6, 40.4, 100, 99.8, ...

Rooted; includes branch lengths.
> y
'treedata' S4 object'.

...@ phylo: 
Phylogenetic tree with 12 tips and 23 internal nodes.

Tip labels:
    SP1, SP2, SP3, SP4, SP5, SP6, ...
Node labels:
    Root, 71.5, 87.6, 40.4, 100, 100, ...

Unrooted; includes branch lengths.

with the following features available:
    'dN_vs_dS'.
>

The internal node number of the original tree is 11 while in y is 23. The tree in y is not in correct structure. This is the reason the ggtree crash.

If you can make sure that the labels are unique to each node, please use internal node number in the metadata instead of label.
